in_hebrew.name: Gasperoni
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gasperoni הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Italian name Gasparo, which originated from the Persian name Gaspar. The name Gaspar means 'treasurer' or 'bringer of treasure' in Persian. In the biblical story of the Magi, Gaspar is one of the three wise men who visited the baby Jesus.
